verdict.rationale: Simular documents its own headless, programmatic interfaces: an HTTPS API (`POST /v1/agents/message`), a Python SDK, and a standalone simulang CLI. Tasks run on Simular-hosted cloud computers, approval requests can be answered programmatically via `POST /v1/agents/approve`, and saved workflows replay as code and rerun on a schedule. That covers the core of driving it non-interactively from scripts or pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline docs (e.g., GitHub Actions examples or exit-code/non-interactive mode guidance), a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
